create_mesh_format_interpreter: create a subclass of MeshFormatInterpreter to read and write mesh files in a custom format
create_pointcloud_format_interpreter: create a subclass of PointcloudFormatInterpreter to read and write point cloud files in a custom format
implement_mesh_read: implement the read method on a MeshFormatInterpreter subclass to load a Meshes object from a file
implement_mesh_save: implement the save method on a MeshFormatInterpreter subclass to write a Meshes object to a file
